estimates.rationale: Full vertical slice from scratch: DB schema + Alembic migration, SQLAlchemy model, repository, service, API boundary, React SPA list page + filing form + empty-state + inline validation, and E2E harness setup — meaningful breadth across every layer, but tightly scoped to one entity (stock record) at one location.

Builds on FP1 infrastructure but adds three non-trivial cross-cutting concerns: optimistic in-place UI update (no reload, R5), transactional below-zero guard at the service layer (R2), and an audit trail capturing timestamp + actor on every adjustment (R1) — each adds testable behaviour across the boundary/service/repository stack.

Introduces a new domain aggregate (inbound receipt, supplier-attributed event) with its own table, model, and write path that increments stock — comparable scope to FP1 but layered on top of existing infrastructure; the supplier-attribution adds a relationship and referential-integrity concern beyond a bare adjustment.

Introduces an outbound-pick aggregate and must enforce a no-overcommit invariant atomically at write time (check-then-decrement with row-level locking or a guarded UPDATE), plus inline rejection UX surfacing the exact shortfall; the concurrency-safe enforcement logic and new domain object keep this at medium scope.

Primarily a new read path and SPA view: the data model already supports multiple (sku, location) rows via FP1's unique constraint, so this is a new aggregate-query endpoint + SKU detail page with a location list — no new write logic, no new schema objects, no new enforcement rules.
